description: Defines the NetworkErrorLoggingService class and related data structures for handling network error logging, policies, and reports within the Chromium project.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService
classes.description: Main class managing network error logging policies, reports, and storage.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::PersistentNelStore
classes.description: Abstract class for persistent storage of NEL policies.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::NelPolicyKey
classes.description: Key representing a (NIK, origin) pair for NEL policies.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::WildcardNelPolicyKey
classes.description: Key for wildcard policies applicable to domains and subdomains.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::NelPolicy
classes.description: Structure representing a NEL policy with associated data.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::RequestDetails
classes.description: Details of a network error for reporting.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::SignedExchangeReportDetails
classes.description: Details of a signed exchange report.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a NetworkErrorLoggingService instance with optional persistent store.

methods.name: SetReportingService
methods.description: Assigns a ReportingService to the NEL service.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the NEL service, preventing further processing.

methods.name: SetClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom clock for testing purposes.

methods.name: StatusAsValue
methods.description: Returns a Value representing current policies and status.

methods.name: GetPolicyKeysForTesting
methods.description: Returns current policy keys, including expired ones, for testing.

methods.name: GetPersistentNelStoreForTesting
methods.description: Returns the persistent store instance for testing.

methods.name: GetReportingServiceForTesting
methods.description: Returns the reporting service instance for testing.
